# Village Naturopathy: full text of key pages

# Naturopathic Approach to Fatigue

> Always tired but your labs are 'normal'? Naturopathic care for fatigue, burnout, low iron and B12, and post-viral fatigue. Virtual care for the UK & Ontario.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/fatigue/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

Village Naturopathy offers virtual naturopathic care for persistent fatigue across the UK and Ontario. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, combines thorough history-taking with key lab markers such as iron, B12, thyroid markers and cortisol to find what is draining your energy, then builds a personalised plan.

## Helping you come back to feeling like yourself

You’re doing all the right things, but you still can’t shake the 2 p.m. slump. You have trouble falling asleep, deal with brain fog, and wake up tired. You’re relying on coffee or matcha more than you’d like to. Your doctor says your labs are fine, but you don’t feel fine. We combine thorough history-taking with key lab markers to identify the sources of your fatigue.

## Conditions we support

- Burnout & adrenal fatigue
- Postpartum fatigue
- Nutrient deficiencies (e.g. iron and B12)
- Post-viral fatigue

## How we work with you

- Initial Consultation: A 75-minute initial consultation with a comprehensive look at your health history, relevant labs and what you’ve tried before.
- Root-Cause Investigation: Comprehensive blood work looking at nutrient status, hormones and cortisol, with more in-depth testing if needed. Testing isn’t required to start care. Any testing is recommended case by case, based on your individual needs.
- Targeted Treatment: We start with the most foundational causes of fatigue identified through your history and labs, then layer on support as needed using nutrition, supplementation, botanical medicine and lifestyle interventions.
- Ongoing Care: Regular appointments that adapt to your needs, so we can follow up on your progress and make adjustments as needed.

## Fees

Initial consultation (75 minutes): £200. Follow-ups: £50–170. Free 15-minute discovery call.

## Frequently asked questions

### Why am I always tired even though my blood work is normal?

Standard blood work often checks only a few markers, and ‘normal’ ranges are broad. We look more closely at nutrient status, thyroid function, hormones and cortisol, alongside your sleep, stress and lifestyle, to find what’s draining your energy.

### What tests do you use to investigate fatigue?

Usually comprehensive blood work, including iron, B12, vitamin D, thyroid markers and hormones. More in-depth testing is only recommended if it’s needed for you.

### Can low iron or B12 cause fatigue?

Yes. Iron and B12 deficiencies are among the most common and most overlooked causes of fatigue, especially for women with heavy periods, plant-based diets or digestive issues.

### Can a naturopath help with burnout?

Yes. We look at how long-term stress has affected your sleep, hormones, nervous system and nutrient levels, then build a plan to help you rebuild your energy step by step.

### How long does it take to get my energy back?

It depends on what’s driving your fatigue. Many patients notice changes within 4–8 weeks, with a full plan typically running 3–6 months.

### Is this covered by insurance?

Naturopathic consultations are covered by many extended health plans in Ontario. Check with your provider for your specific coverage. Appointments are virtual, and available to patients in Ontario and the UK.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.




# Naturopathic Gut Health Treatment

> Root-cause naturopathic care for IBS, SIBO, bloating, food sensitivities and reflux. Virtual consultations for the UK & Ontario. Free discovery call.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/gut-health/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

Village Naturopathy offers virtual naturopathic care for IBS, SIBO, bloating, reflux and food sensitivities across the UK and Ontario. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, reviews your digestive history in a 75-minute consultation and, where testing is useful, uses GI-MAP stool analysis or SIBO breath testing to guide a tailored plan.

## When your gut is running the show

Bloating after every meal, nausea that comes and goes, foods you used to love now causing problems. You’ve cut out dairy, gluten and sugar, and still feel terrible. Digestive issues aren’t just uncomfortable; they affect your energy, your mood, your hormones, and your immune system. We look beyond the symptoms to find what’s actually driving the dysfunction.

## Conditions we treat

- IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome)
- SIBO (Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth)
- Bloating & gas
- Constipation & diarrhoea
- Food sensitivities & intolerances
- Acid reflux & GERD
- Leaky gut (intestinal permeability)
- Candida overgrowth
- Inflammatory bowel conditions

## How we work with you

- Comprehensive Assessment: A 75-minute initial consultation with a thorough review of your digestive history, diet, stress patterns, medication use and symptom timeline.
- Functional Testing: GI-MAP stool analysis, SIBO breath testing, food sensitivity panels, and organic acids testing to identify the root cause. Testing isn’t required to start care. Any testing is recommended case by case, based on your individual needs.
- Tailored Gut Protocol: Through careful history-taking and relevant testing, we create a plan to correct the terrain of your gut, optimise your microbiome and address the other factors that influence gut health, such as nutrient deficiencies and stress. Treatment uses nutraceuticals, botanicals and dietary changes as part of a holistic, whole-person approach.
- Ongoing Monitoring: Regular check-ins to track symptom resolution, adjust the protocol, and retest when needed.

## Fees

Initial consultation (75 minutes): £200. Follow-ups: £50–170. Free 15-minute discovery call.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a GI-MAP test and do I need one?

GI-MAP is a comprehensive stool test that uses DNA analysis to identify pathogens, parasites, bacterial imbalances, inflammation markers, and digestive function. It’s one of the most detailed gut tests available. Not everyone needs testing. We recommend it based on your symptoms and history.

### How long does it take to heal your gut naturally?

It depends on the condition. Simple dysbiosis may resolve in 6–8 weeks. More complex issues like SIBO or inflammatory conditions typically take 3–6 months of structured treatment.

### Do I need to follow a restrictive diet?

Short-term dietary modifications are sometimes helpful, but the goal is always to expand your diet, not restrict it permanently. We focus on healing the gut so you can enjoy food again.

### Can gut health affect my mood?

Absolutely. The gut-brain axis is a well-established connection. Around 90% of the body’s serotonin is produced in the gut, and gut inflammation directly impacts mood, anxiety, and cognitive function.

### Can a naturopath help with IBS or SIBO?

Yes. We look for what’s driving your symptoms, whether that’s bacterial overgrowth, low stomach acid, stress or food triggers, and build a targeted plan using nutrition, botanicals and nutraceuticals. SIBO breath testing is available when it’s useful.

### Why am I bloated after every meal?

Persistent bloating can come from several causes, including SIBO, food intolerances, low digestive enzymes or stress affecting digestion. An assessment helps identify which ones apply to you.

### Do you offer online gut health consultations in the UK?

Yes. All appointments are virtual, and Dr. Heather sees patients across the UK and Ontario.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.




# Naturopathic Hormone Balancing

> Root-cause naturopathic care for PMOS/PCOS, PMS, PMDD, endometriosis, irregular periods and hormonal acne. Virtual care for the UK & Ontario. Free discovery call.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/hormone-balancing/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

Village Naturopathy offers virtual naturopathic hormone care across the UK and Ontario. After a 75-minute consultation, Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, uses your cycle history, symptoms and, where appropriate, DUTCH hormone testing and blood work to build a personalised plan for PMOS/PCOS, PMS and PMDD, endometriosis, irregular periods and hormonal acne.

## When your hormones feel out of your control

Irregular periods, weight changes that don’t make sense, skin that won’t clear, mood swings that leave you feeling like a different person. You’ve tried everything and nothing sticks. Hormone imbalances don’t resolve on their own. We use comprehensive testing to understand your unique hormonal picture and build a plan that restores balance from the inside out.

## Conditions we treat

- PMOS/PCOS (Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome)
- PMS & PMDD
- Heavy or painful periods
- Endometriosis
- Irregular or absent periods
- Hormonal acne
- Fertility support
- Post-pill syndrome

## How we work with you

- Comprehensive Assessment: A 75-minute initial consultation with a detailed look at your menstrual history, symptoms, lifestyle, stress load and health goals.
- Testing: Comprehensive blood work, DUTCH hormone testing, thyroid panels and nutrient status to map your unique hormonal landscape. Testing isn’t required to start care. Any testing is recommended case by case, based on your individual needs.
- Targeted Treatment: Clinical nutrition, targeted supplementation, evidence-based botanical medicine, lifestyle and adjunctive support designed to restore hormonal rhythm naturally.
- Cycle-Aligned Support: Follow-ups timed to your cycle so we can track progress and adjust your plan in real time.

## Fees

Initial consultation (75 minutes): £200. Follow-ups: £50–170. Free 15-minute discovery call.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is DUTCH testing?

DUTCH (Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones) measures your sex hormones, cortisol pattern, and hormone metabolites. It gives us a far more detailed picture than standard blood work alone.

### Can naturopathy help with PMOS/PCOS?

Yes. PMOS (Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome) is the updated name for PCOS. Naturopathic treatment focuses on insulin regulation, reducing inflammation and supporting hormone balance through nutrition, botanicals and lifestyle changes, addressing the root drivers rather than just the symptoms.

### Can a naturopath help with irregular or painful periods?

Yes. We look at what’s driving your cycle changes, from nutrient status and blood sugar to stress and inflammation, and build a plan to support a healthier, more comfortable cycle.

### Can naturopathy help with PMS or PMDD?

Yes. We assess how your hormones, nervous system and nutrition interact across your cycle, then use targeted nutrition, supplementation and botanicals to reduce symptoms month to month.

### Do you offer online hormone consultations in the UK?

Yes. All appointments are virtual, and Dr. Heather sees patients across the UK and Ontario.

### How long does hormone balancing take?

Hormonal shifts typically take 3–6 menstrual cycles to fully manifest. Most patients notice improvements in energy and mood within the first month.

### Do I need to stop birth control?

Not necessarily. We work with wherever you are. If you’re considering coming off hormonal contraception, we can support that transition.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.




# Naturopathic Care for Stress, Mood & Anxiety

> Root-cause naturopathic care for chronic stress, anxiety, low mood and burnout. Virtual consultations for Ontario & the UK. Book a free discovery call.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/services/stress-anxiety/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

Village Naturopathy offers virtual naturopathic care for stress, anxiety, low mood and burnout across the UK and Ontario. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, starts with a 75-minute consultation, looks at your sleep, nervous system, hormones, gut and nutrient status, then builds a personalised plan.

## When stress becomes your baseline

You’ve been running on adrenaline for so long it feels normal. The sleep issues, the afternoon crashes, the tight shoulders, the brain fog: they’ve become part of your identity. But your body is telling you something. Naturopathic medicine looks at the full picture of your nervous system, your hormones, your gut and your lifestyle, and builds a path back to feeling grounded.

## Conditions we treat

- Chronic stress & overwhelm
- Generalised anxiety disorder
- Panic attacks
- Burnout & adrenal fatigue
- Insomnia & sleep disturbances
- Nervous system dysregulation
- Depression & low mood
- PMDD

## How we work with you

- Comprehensive Assessment: A 75-minute initial consultation to understand your stress history, triggers, lifestyle, and health goals.
- Comprehensive Testing: Comprehensive blood work, DUTCH hormone testing, cortisol mapping and nutrient status to see what’s happening beneath the surface. Testing isn’t required to start care. Any testing is recommended case by case, based on your individual needs.
- Personalised Plan: Evidence-based botanical medicine, targeted nutrition, nervous system regulation techniques, and lifestyle modifications tailored to you.
- Ongoing Support: Regular follow-ups and adjustments to your plan as you progress. You’re never doing this alone.

## Fees

Initial consultation (75 minutes): £200. Follow-ups: £50–170. Free 15-minute discovery call.

## Frequently asked questions

### What causes chronic stress and anxiety?

Chronic stress is rarely caused by one thing. It’s usually a combination of lifestyle factors, unresolved trauma, hormonal imbalances, nutrient deficiencies, and nervous system dysregulation. Naturopathic medicine looks at all of these together.

### How does naturopathy treat anxiety differently?

Rather than masking symptoms, we identify root causes, whether that’s a cortisol imbalance, gut-brain axis disruption or a mineral deficiency, and address them with targeted nutrition, botanicals and nervous system tools.

### Can a naturopath help with anxiety?

A naturopathic doctor can look at the physical contributors to anxiety, such as blood sugar swings, nutrient status, hormones, sleep and gut health, and support them alongside the lifestyle and nervous system factors. Appointments are virtual, for patients across the UK and Ontario. Naturopathic care is complementary, so we work alongside your GP or mental health team.

### What is the best natural treatment for stress and anxiety?

There is no single best option, because stress looks different in every person. A plan usually combines nutrition, targeted supplementation, botanical medicine, sleep support and nervous system regulation practices, chosen after a full history and, where useful, testing. Dr. Heather approves the plan with you, step by step.

### Can naturopathy help with PMDD or low mood?

Naturopathic care can support the hormonal, nutritional and nervous system factors that often sit behind PMDD and low mood, and it works alongside medical care. Virtual consultations are available in the UK and Ontario. If you are struggling with thoughts of harming yourself, please contact your GP or emergency services straight away, or call Samaritans on 116 123 (UK) or 988 (Canada).

### How long does treatment typically take?

Most patients notice improvements within 4–6 weeks. A comprehensive treatment plan typically spans 3–6 months, with follow-ups adjusted to your pace.

### Do you work alongside my GP or therapist?

Absolutely. Naturopathic care is integrative, and we collaborate with your existing healthcare team to ensure a cohesive approach.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.

# DUTCH Hormone Test in the UK

> DUTCH hormone testing for UK patients, explained by Dr. Heather Robinson, ND. Home collection, cortisol patterns and hormone metabolites.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/uk/dutch-test/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

DUTCH (Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones) is a home hormone test that measures sex hormones, their metabolites and the daily pattern of cortisol. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, recommends it case by case for UK patients and explains what it measures, how it works and what it costs before you decide.

## What the DUTCH test is

DUTCH stands for Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones. You collect small dried urine samples at home on filter paper, usually four samples across a day, and send them to the laboratory. It measures sex hormones such as oestrogen, progesterone and testosterone, plus their metabolites, and the daily pattern of cortisol. Some versions of the test also look at markers linked to melatonin, oxidative stress, and certain B vitamins. A DUTCH report adds detail to your history. It does not diagnose a condition on its own, and results are always interpreted alongside your symptoms and other tests.

## When it can be useful

Dr. Heather may recommend DUTCH testing when cycles are irregular or difficult, when symptoms suggest a hormone pattern that blood tests do not explain, when you are coming off hormonal contraception, or when cortisol rhythm looks relevant to sleep and energy. It is never required to start care.

## How it works with Village Naturopathy

Testing starts with a conversation. Dr. Heather explains what the test would add, how the kit reaches you, what it costs and what to do on the day, before you decide. Results are reviewed with you in a follow-up appointment and fed into your plan.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a DUTCH test?

DUTCH (Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones) is a home test that measures sex hormones, cortisol patterns and hormone metabolites from dried urine samples collected over a day.

### Do I need a DUTCH test to start?

No. Testing is not required to start care. Dr. Heather recommends it case by case, based on your individual needs.

### Can I do a DUTCH test at home in the UK?

DUTCH is a home collection test. Dr. Heather will explain how the kit reaches you and what to do before you decide to order it.

### Does a DUTCH test diagnose a condition?

No. It adds detail to your history and is interpreted alongside your symptoms and other tests. It does not diagnose a condition on its own.

### How much does it cost?

The initial 75-minute consultation is £200 and follow-ups are £50–170. Dr. Heather will explain the cost of any recommended testing before you decide.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.

# DUTCH Hormone Test in Belfast

> DUTCH hormone testing for patients in Belfast, explained by Dr. Heather Robinson, ND. Home collection, cortisol and hormone metabolites.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/uk/belfast/dutch-test/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

DUTCH is a home hormone test, so patients in Belfast do not need to travel to a lab or clinic. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, recommends it case by case and explains what it measures, how it works and what it costs before you decide. It is interpreted alongside your history and is never required to start care.

## What the DUTCH test is

DUTCH stands for Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones. You collect small dried urine samples at home on filter paper, usually four samples across a day, and send them to the laboratory. It measures sex hormones such as oestrogen, progesterone and testosterone, plus their metabolites, and the daily pattern of cortisol. Some versions of the test also look at markers linked to melatonin, oxidative stress, and certain B vitamins. A DUTCH report adds detail to your history. It does not diagnose a condition on its own, and results are always interpreted alongside your symptoms and other tests.

## When it can be useful

Dr. Heather may recommend DUTCH testing when cycles are irregular or difficult, when symptoms suggest a hormone pattern that blood tests do not explain, when you are coming off hormonal contraception, or when cortisol rhythm looks relevant to sleep and energy. It is never required to start care.

## How it works with Village Naturopathy

Testing starts with a conversation. Dr. Heather explains what the test would add, how the kit reaches you, what it costs and what to do on the day, before you decide. Results are reviewed with you in a follow-up appointment and fed into your plan.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a DUTCH test?

DUTCH (Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones) is a home test that measures sex hormones, cortisol patterns and hormone metabolites from dried urine samples collected over a day.

### Do I need a DUTCH test to start?

No. Testing is not required to start care. Dr. Heather recommends it case by case, based on your individual needs.

### Can I do a DUTCH test at home in the UK?

DUTCH is a home collection test. Dr. Heather will explain how the kit reaches you and what to do before you decide to order it.

### Does a DUTCH test diagnose a condition?

No. It adds detail to your history and is interpreted alongside your symptoms and other tests. It does not diagnose a condition on its own.

### How much does it cost?

The initial 75-minute consultation is £200 and follow-ups are £50–170. Dr. Heather will explain the cost of any recommended testing before you decide.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.

# DUTCH Hormone Test in London

> DUTCH hormone testing for patients in London, explained by Dr. Heather Robinson, ND. Home collection, cortisol and hormone metabolites.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/uk/london/dutch-test/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

DUTCH is a home hormone test, so patients in London do not need to travel to a lab or clinic. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, recommends it case by case and explains what it measures, how it works and what it costs before you decide. It is interpreted alongside your history and is never required to start care.

## What the DUTCH test is

DUTCH stands for Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones. You collect small dried urine samples at home on filter paper, usually four samples across a day, and send them to the laboratory. It measures sex hormones such as oestrogen, progesterone and testosterone, plus their metabolites, and the daily pattern of cortisol. Some versions of the test also look at markers linked to melatonin, oxidative stress, and certain B vitamins. A DUTCH report adds detail to your history. It does not diagnose a condition on its own, and results are always interpreted alongside your symptoms and other tests.

## When it can be useful

Dr. Heather may recommend DUTCH testing when cycles are irregular or difficult, when symptoms suggest a hormone pattern that blood tests do not explain, when you are coming off hormonal contraception, or when cortisol rhythm looks relevant to sleep and energy. It is never required to start care.

## How it works with Village Naturopathy

Testing starts with a conversation. Dr. Heather explains what the test would add, how the kit reaches you, what it costs and what to do on the day, before you decide. Results are reviewed with you in a follow-up appointment and fed into your plan.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a DUTCH test?

DUTCH (Dried Urine Test for Comprehensive Hormones) is a home test that measures sex hormones, cortisol patterns and hormone metabolites from dried urine samples collected over a day.

### Do I need a DUTCH test to start?

No. Testing is not required to start care. Dr. Heather recommends it case by case, based on your individual needs.

### Can I do a DUTCH test at home in the UK?

DUTCH is a home collection test. Dr. Heather will explain how the kit reaches you and what to do before you decide to order it.

### Does a DUTCH test diagnose a condition?

No. It adds detail to your history and is interpreted alongside your symptoms and other tests. It does not diagnose a condition on its own.

### How much does it cost?

The initial 75-minute consultation is £200 and follow-ups are £50–170. Dr. Heather will explain the cost of any recommended testing before you decide.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.




# Fatigue Naturopath in London

> Online naturopath in London for persistent fatigue, low iron and B12, post-viral fatigue and burnout. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND. Free discovery call.

## Summary

## Always tired, but your labs are ‘normal’?

Standard blood tests check only a few markers, and reference ranges are broad. A naturopathic assessment looks more closely at nutrient status, thyroid function, hormones and cortisol, alongside your sleep, stress and lifestyle.

## Common contributors

Low iron or B12, thyroid imbalance, blood sugar swings, long-term stress, poor sleep, post-viral recovery and hormone changes are among the most common contributors to fatigue. Iron and B12 deficiencies are especially easy to overlook in women with heavy periods, plant-based diets or digestive issues.

## Your plan

Dr. Heather starts with the most foundational causes identified through your history and labs, then layers on support using nutrition, supplementation, botanical medicine and lifestyle changes. Follow-ups adapt to your progress.

## Frequently asked questions

### Why am I always tired even though my blood work is normal?

Standard blood work often checks only a few markers, and ‘normal’ ranges are broad. A closer look at nutrient status, thyroid function, hormones and cortisol, alongside sleep and stress, may find what is draining your energy.

### Can low iron or B12 cause fatigue?

Yes. Iron and B12 deficiencies are among the most common and most overlooked causes of fatigue.

### Do you offer online appointments in London?

Yes, all consultations are by secure video.

### When should I see my GP?

If your fatigue is sudden, severe or comes with other worrying symptoms, see your GP promptly. Naturopathic care is complementary to medical care.

# Gut Health Naturopath in London

> Online naturopath in London for IBS, SIBO, bloating, reflux and food sensitivities. GI-MAP and SIBO testing where useful. Free discovery call.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/uk/london/gut-health/

Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, reviews your digestive history in a 75-minute consultation and, where useful, recommends GI-MAP stool analysis or SIBO breath testing to guide a tailored plan.

## Why the gut is often the missing link

Your gut influences hormones, immunity, mood and energy, and it is itself influenced by stress, sleep, medication and diet. If you have cut out foods, tried supplements and still bloat after meals, the cause may be more specific than a single trigger.

## How we investigate

Dr. Heather starts with your history, symptoms, diet, stress and medication. Where testing will change the plan, she may recommend GI-MAP stool analysis, SIBO breath testing or food sensitivity panels, and always explains the process and cost first. The plan is phased: remove triggers, replace what is missing, support beneficial bacteria and repair the gut lining with nutrition, botanicals and nutraceuticals.

## Alongside medical care

Gut symptoms can sometimes signal conditions that need medical assessment. If you have blood in your stool, unexplained weight loss, persistent vomiting or severe pain, please see your GP promptly. Naturopathic care is complementary to medical care.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can a naturopath help with IBS or SIBO?

Naturopathic care looks for what is driving your symptoms, whether that is bacterial overgrowth, low stomach acid, stress or food triggers, and builds a plan using nutrition, botanicals and nutraceuticals. SIBO breath testing is available when it is useful.

### Do I need a GI-MAP test?

Not everyone needs testing. It is recommended based on your symptoms and history.

### Do you offer online gut health consultations in London?

Yes, all consultations are by secure video.

### How much does it cost?

The initial 75-minute consultation is £200, follow-ups are £50–170, and the discovery call is free.

# Hormone Balancing Naturopath in London

> Online naturopath in London for hormone health: PMS and PMDD, irregular periods, endometriosis and hormonal acne. Free discovery call.

## Summary

Village Naturopathy offers online hormone-focused naturopathic care for women in London. After a 75-minute consultation with Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, you receive a personalised plan that can include nutrition, targeted supplementation, botanical medicine and, where it is useful, DUTCH hormone testing and blood work.

## What hormone-focused naturopathic care looks like

Hormone symptoms rarely have a single cause. Cycles are influenced by stress, sleep, blood sugar, thyroid function, gut health, nutrient status and the way your body clears hormones. A naturopathic assessment looks at those together instead of treating each symptom in isolation. Dr. Heather starts with a detailed history: your cycle, symptoms, contraceptive history, stress load and goals. From there she recommends testing only where it will change the plan, and builds a programme of nutrition, targeted supplements, botanical medicine and lifestyle support.

## Common reasons London patients get in touch

PMS and PMDD that disrupt work and home life, irregular, heavy or painful periods, PMOS/PCOS, endometriosis, hormonal acne, post-pill syndrome and fertility support. Many arrive after being told their standard blood results are fine, and still know that something is off. The plan is personalised, so a cycle-tracking approach for one person may look quite different from the approach for someone else, even if the label on the symptoms is the same.

## Testing, if it helps

Comprehensive blood work and DUTCH hormone testing can give a clearer picture of sex hormones, cortisol patterns and hormone metabolites. Testing is never required to start care. Dr. Heather recommends it case by case and explains the cost and logistics first.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can a naturopath help with irregular or painful periods?

Naturopathic care can look at what is driving cycle changes, from nutrient status and blood sugar to stress and inflammation, and build a plan to support a healthier cycle. It works alongside, not instead of, your GP.

### Do you offer online hormone consultations in London?

Yes. All appointments are by secure video, so you can attend from home or work anywhere in London.

### Do I need to stop the pill to see you?

Not necessarily. Dr. Heather works with wherever you are, including if you are considering coming off hormonal contraception.

### How much does it cost?

# PMOS/PCOS Naturopath in London

> Online naturopath in London for PMOS/PCOS (Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome). Insulin, inflammation and cycle support. Free discovery call.

Canonical: https://villagenaturopathy.com/uk/london/pmos-pcos/
Practitioner: Dr. Heather Robinson, ND (Village Naturopathy)
Booking: https://villagenaturopathy.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1

## Summary

PMOS (Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome) is the updated name for PCOS. Village Naturopathy offers online naturopathic support for PMOS/PCOS in London, looking at insulin and blood sugar, inflammation, androgens, stress and cycle patterns with a personalised plan from Dr. Heather Robinson, ND.

## PMOS or PCOS: what is the difference?

PCOS (polycystic ovary syndrome) has recently been renamed PMOS, Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome, to reflect that the condition is not just about the ovaries. It involves metabolic, hormonal and often inflammatory factors, and people now search for both names. This site uses PMOS/PCOS for that reason.

## How a naturopathic approach works

The drivers of PMOS/PCOS vary: insulin resistance and blood sugar swings, raised androgens, chronic inflammation, gut health and stress can all play a part. Dr. Heather takes a thorough history, recommends testing where useful and builds a plan around nutrition, supplements, botanical medicine and lifestyle changes you can sustain. Care is complementary and works alongside your GP or specialist. Many people also use the PMOS Playbook, a self-guided 90-day plan, alongside one-to-one care.

## What to expect from your first appointment

Your first consultation is 75 minutes by secure video. You will cover your cycle history, symptoms, nutrition, stress, sleep and medication, and leave with an outline of the next steps. Testing is optional and recommended case by case.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can naturopathy help with PMOS/PCOS?

Naturopathic treatment focuses on insulin regulation, reducing inflammation and supporting hormone balance through nutrition, botanicals and lifestyle changes, addressing the root drivers rather than only the symptoms.

### Is PMOS the same as PCOS?

PMOS (Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome) is the updated name for PCOS. People now search both names.

### Do I need testing before booking?

No. Testing is not required to start care. Dr. Heather recommends it case by case, based on your individual needs.

### Do you offer PMOS/PCOS appointments online in London?

Yes, all consultations are by secure video.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.

# Burnout & Stress Naturopath in London

## Summary

Village Naturopathy offers online naturopathic care for burnout, chronic stress, anxiety and low mood for people in London. Dr. Heather Robinson, ND, looks at your nervous system, sleep, hormones, gut and nutrient status, then builds a personalised plan that fits a demanding London schedule.

## When stress becomes your baseline

London rewards people who keep going. After enough years of early starts, late evenings and constant availability, being tired, tense and slightly on edge starts to feel normal. But persistent stress affects sleep, digestion, hormones and mood, and those effects can be investigated and supported.

## How we approach burnout and stress

Dr. Heather combines a thorough history with the physical contributors: blood sugar, nutrient status, cortisol patterns, thyroid function and gut health. The plan usually includes nutrition, targeted supplementation, botanical medicine, nervous system regulation techniques and realistic changes to your routine. She is also a Certified HeartMath Practitioner and integrates those techniques where they are useful.

## Working with your GP

Naturopathic care is complementary. If you are also seeing a GP or therapist, Dr. Heather is happy to work alongside them. If your mood is very low or you are struggling to cope, please contact your GP or a crisis service as well.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can a naturopath help with burnout?

Naturopathic care can look at how long-term stress has affected your sleep, hormones, nervous system and nutrient levels, then build a plan to help you rebuild your energy step by step.

### Do you offer online appointments in London?

Yes, all consultations are by secure video, so you can attend from home or work.

### How long does it take to see a difference?

It depends on you. Many people notice some changes within a few weeks, and a full plan usually runs three to six months.

### How much does it cost?

The initial 75-minute consultation is £200, follow-ups are £50–170, and the discovery call is free.

---
Naturopathic care is complementary and does not replace advice from your GP or other healthcare professional. If your symptoms are severe, sudden or worrying, contact your GP or local urgent care service, or call 999 in an emergency.
